posts.name: S.Space
posts.tagline: Your team and everyone's AI agents, in one workspace
posts.description: Everyone on your team has an AI agent, and none of them work together, so you copy, paste and re-explain all day. S.Space is one workspace for your team and everyone's agents. Bring the ones you already use, like Claude Code and Codex, from any vendor. Agents reach out, hand work to each other and bring you finished results, with shared memory so you explain things once. Agents act, you approve what matters. Free to start. Built by the team behind AutoGen.

posts.name: Bluedot Phone Calls
posts.tagline: AI note taker for phone calls
posts.description: Bluedot now covers phone calls, not just meetings. Dial from the web or mobile app, keep your own caller ID, and get a transcript, summary and action items automatically.

posts.name: Toone
posts.tagline: Grokbot meets n8n/zapier
posts.description: Toone: Grokbot meets n8n/zapier. Build precise agentic workflows and routines in natural language. Each node is an agent's chat thread on the model you pick (ChatGPT or Claude), or an automatic step that runs the same way every time without AI. Run repeatable routines, babysit them with agents, polish as they run, pause and continue anytime. Plus live share, meeting notes, Spotlight-style layouts, Zen Mode, Calendar, Quick Capture, Git, and MCPs for research, SEO and more.

posts.name: Waldo by Wherobots
posts.tagline: The AI agent that accelerates engineering with spatial data
posts.description: Waldo is the geospatial data agent that turns questions about the physical world into answers, maps, and production-ready data pipelines. It analyzes satellite imagery, geometries, geography data, and your organization's first party data, writes and debugs the analysis, and delivers results in hours. When the work needs to run continuously, Waldo turns it into a scheduled pipeline on your existing data platform. Built for spatial analytics at scale by the creators of Apache Sedona.

posts.name: Dippr
posts.tagline: A data platform served to your agents, with one prompt
posts.description: It’s where your agents build and run your company’s software, tools and apps – with access to your company data across sources, the context to understand it, and the rules to use it safely.

posts.name: Pitch Avatar HR Suite
posts.tagline: Onboarding, training & comms with conversational AI avatars
posts.description: HR teams should be talking to people. Instead, up to 70% of the day goes to onboarding, mandatory training, and the same questions again and again, with no way to tell what works. HR Suite automates it with conversational AI avatars. They teach from your materials and answer employees’ questions in lessons and as an HR assistant. Reminders keep people on track; HR sees who finished and where they got stuck. Free 14-day trial + 50% off any plan with code PRODUCTHUNT2026 until Nov 30.

posts.name: Mermaid Flow
posts.tagline: The visual builder for agentic workflows
posts.description: Mermaid Flow lets you build agentic workflows as diagrams, then run them. Think issue triage, weekly recaps, PR reviews: work you'd otherwise hand to a long prompt or a skill file. Describe what you want, start from a template, or bring the file, and you get a workflow with every step laid out. Connect Github, Slack, Notion, and more in one click, then hit run or put it on a schedule. Every run is saved step by step, so you can see what happened and your team can follow along. Free to start.

posts.name: dusk bot
posts.tagline: free open source Grok bot alternative
posts.description: Best free Grok bot alternative. Use the ChatGPT, Claude or Grok plan you already pay for and get a team of bots, each with a job, a memory you can edit and its own computer. They run on a schedule, ask before risky steps, and live in a calm, polished chat app. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, OpenRouter or a local model, on your own sign-in. 100% free and open source

posts.name: Review Box
posts.tagline: A fast desktop app for reviewing GitHub pull requests
posts.description: A fast desktop app for reviewing GitHub pull requests. Track reviewed files, jump to symbol definitions and uses, search the whole PR and ask AI about changes.

posts.name: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
posts.tagline: Two new OpenAI models: frontier Astra and efficient Sol
posts.description: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are OpenAI’s new models for professional work. Astra is the frontier model for the hardest projects, like slides, websites, 3D designs and science research. Sol is the efficient everyday model for coding and multistep agent work. Per OpenAI, Astra costs under a third per task of GPT-6 Astra. API pricing per million tokens: Astra $8 in, $40 out; Sol $2 in, $10 out. Live in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu, plus the API.

posts.name: Incredible Agents
posts.tagline: Fast Voice AI that sees your screen and runs your agents
posts.description: The heavily asked for INCREDIBLE AGENTS update is finally here! Your voice can now: (1) CREATE new agents that work directly on your computer, in apps, browsers and files. (2) RUN work on repeat, 24/7. (3) BUILD live sharable pages, dashboards, apps and more. Incredible PROACTIVELY FINDS WORK AI agents can do for you, and sets the agent up. Agents do the work directly on your computer, the way you do, 24/7. FREE TO TRY. Mac and Windows.

posts.name: Tencent Hy4 flash
posts.tagline: Fast, low-cost model from $0.07/M input
posts.description: Hy4 flash is Tencent’s most cost-effective Hy model to date, with 224B total parameters, 12B active, multimodal input and a 1M-token context. Per Tencent, it decodes above 150 tokens per second and costs about $0.07 per million input tokens and $0.28 output. It targets everyday tasks like document work, slides, deep research and computer use, while Hy4 handles harder engineering. Open-sourcing is planned, but the weights are not out yet.

posts.name: Replay QA Self-healing Mode
posts.tagline: Turn user frustration into verified fixes
posts.description: Self-healing Mode turns frustrated user sessions into root-caused bug reports with evidence, sent to your issue tracker or straight to your coding agent. - always-on user session capture (powered by Fullstory) - automatic detection of user frustration signals - Bug reports with detailed root-cause analysis + runtime evidence - pipe them into your issue tracker of choice or straight to your coding agent or factory loop - Daily summary reports of what users did

posts.name: lepoly
posts.tagline: One place for all your 3D assets
posts.description: lepoly is a digital asset management platform built for 3D. Host, organize, review, and share, all from the browser.

posts.name: UI Verify
posts.tagline: Visual testing for coding agents
posts.description: UI Verify shows your coding agent every screen its change touched, so the agent catches and fixes its own UI bugs before your users see them. Used by teams at JetBrains, Cura and Metica. Works with Playwright, Storybook, Vitest and Bun, and with iOS and Android apps. Set up in one line. Free to start, and free for open source: 50,000 snapshots a month.

posts.name: Arcade
posts.tagline: AI video generator for marketing teams
posts.description: Arcade is the AI video generator for marketing teams. Describe what you want, answer two questions, and get an on-brand product video in minutes. Start from a prompt, a screen recording, or what you already have in Notion, Linear, Google Drive, GitHub, and Granola. Your Brand Kit, natural voiceover, and every scene editable. Then post straight to YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. Free to start.

posts.name: Introzy
posts.tagline: Track referrals from intro to commission
posts.description: Track every introduction from handshake to commission. Introzy captures referrals, attributes revenue, and pays partners on time - free to start.

posts.name: Polylane for CI
posts.tagline: Fix broken builds before they block your team
posts.description: When CI fails on main or in your merge queue, Polylane reads the job logs, finds the commit that broke the build, and opens a fix pull request. It runs your build and tests before review, fixes CI failures on its own PRs, and closes the issue when main is green again. Works with GitHub Actions, Depot, and CI that reports checks to GitHub.

posts.name: Qwen4-Max
posts.tagline: Qwen's new flagship for long-running agent work
posts.description: Qwen4-Max is the first flagship built on Qwen's new 2.4T-parameter architecture, with native vision and a 1M-token context window. It supports coding, professional workflows, and long-running agent tasks, with API access available now.

posts.name: KaDeep AI
posts.tagline: Agentic QA, localization & accessibility: know when to ship
posts.description: KaDeep Studio Pro is an AI agent that tells you whether a release is ready to ship. Describe a test in plain English and it runs on your web app, iOS or Android build, or desktop app. It localizes 100+ file formats, from app strings and PDFs to Office files, images, SCORM and video, and checks every language in the real build. It audits accessibility under any law: WCAG 2.2, ADA, EAA, Section 508, EN 301 549 and 14 more. Its open-source CLI makes it a go / no-go gate in CI. Free to start.

posts.name: uRun
posts.tagline: Real-time decisions for voice and video agents
posts.description: Sense is a real-time decision model for voice and video agents. It runs on streaming audio and video and answers your questions about the conversation many times per second: is the user done speaking, did they just interrupt, should the agent stop talking. You write the questions, Sense returns the decisions, and your agent acts on them. Build with the SDK for real-time sessions, or send single requests to explore. New accounts start with 1,000 in free credits.

posts.name: Stringman
posts.tagline: Turns your room into a crane game
posts.description: Clean up playrooms, or automate transport in multi-robot setups. Stringman is a room-scale CDPR for pick and place tasks. 2-dof gripper with a 2kg payload. Stays suspended overhead by braided line. MCP control, self parking and low latency grasp network. Teleop from anywhere or keep it air-gapped and local.

posts.name: Happo animation testing
posts.tagline: Visual regression testing, now for animations
posts.description: Happo is visual regression testing and accessibility testing for websites, web apps, and native apps. On every pull request, it screenshots your UI in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge and shows you what changed before it ships. Now Happo tests animations too. It captures every frame, so a change to how something moves shows up as a diff. Step through frame by frame or swipe between before and after. Happo animation testing is free through 2026.

posts.name: SaaS Toolkit MCP
posts.tagline: An SDR and CMO on your site 24/7, for one JavaScript snippet
posts.description: Drop one JavaScript snippet on your site. SaaS Toolkit becomes your 24/7 sales and marketing arm: • AI chat steps in when a visitor is ready to buy or about to leave • Anonymous visitors become named leads • Emails triggered by what they do • Stripe revenue, Slack alerts, ad conversions, webhooks • Add the Website SDR: it calls hot leads and books meetings New: the MCP. Your AI agents run it from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor: ask, reply, follow up. MCP included on every plan, even free Starter.

posts.name: Kino
posts.tagline: Store, edit and review video with Claude Code and Codex
posts.description: Kino lets you make great videos with your agents and your teammates. Storage of footage and assets, a rich video editor, and review links for teammates are all bundled into one. Your colleagues and Codex / Claude Code can work on the same timeline with review notes and footage all in one place. All editing is expressed as code, built on Remotion, so you can drag and nudge anything your agent made without prompting again. The full editor is free.

posts.name: canfit
posts.tagline: The top command for people running local LLMs and apps
posts.description: canfit tells you if a local model or app can launch right now, and if not, what you can safely close to make room. System processes are never touched. Open-source Rust TUI/CLI for macOS, Windows and Linux, no telemetry.

posts.name: AssemblyAI-STT-3.7
posts.tagline: Speech-to-Text for live calls, voice agents, and recordings
posts.description: AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 is a family of three Speech-to-Text models, one for each kind of audio. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7-Realtime is for live meetings and calls, with speaker labels as people talk. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7-Realtime-Agent is for voice agents. AssemblyAI-STT-3.7 is for recorded audio. All three cover 32 languages.

posts.name: AI Canvas
posts.tagline: A design system for AI agents to design badass interfaces
posts.description: No more AI slop. AI Canvas gives your AI agent a real design system to build with. The Andromeda Pro AI Brain tells it which tokens and patterns to use, and its done-gate fails work that drifts off the system. Add standalone React components and effects, 820 React icons in four styles, and one MCP server that lets Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, VS Code and more search and install it all as editable source. Start free with MIT components and Line icons.

posts.name: Afterall Photo
posts.tagline: Line up your after photo exactly with your before
posts.description: Afterall puts your earlier photo on the live camera as a see-through ghost, so every after-shot lines up with the before. Export the change as a crossfade, a reveal or side by side. No account, no server, Pro is a one-time purchase.

posts.name: Beacon
posts.tagline: Give your AI agent the browser you're already signed into
posts.description: Beacon is an MCP extension that lets Cursor, Claude Code and any MCP client work inside your own signed-in Chrome. Read the page, click, type, navigate. Multiple profiles, parallel tasks in tab groups, no cookie export, no cloud browser.

posts.name: Diagramly 2.0
posts.tagline: Type a diagram. Get it reviewed. Present it as the deck.
posts.description: Type Client -> API -> DB and get a hand-drawn diagram. Now send it for review with edit, comment or view-only links, pin comments to shapes, and present it as slides with speaker notes. 18 skins, 10 cheat sheets, Teams. Free, no sign-up.

posts.name: SoreQen Code
posts.tagline: The coding agent that checks its own work
posts.description: SoreQen Code is an autonomous coding agent by ZorQelis AI. Describe a task and it reads your project, makes a plan, edits files, runs commands and tests, checks its own work, and tells you plainly what it did. Use it in the SoreQen desktop app or the open-source CLI, and approve steps from your phone when you are away. It runs on 18 models with one credit balance, and SoreQen Auto picks the right one for each step. Free to start.

posts.name: Dream by Smart Jelly
posts.tagline: An AI agent that works through your tasks overnight
posts.description: Dream helps you make progress on your tasks while you sleep. It works through tasks it can finish on its own overnight and shows you what it did in the morning. Dream is part of Smart Jelly, a Mac app whose tools share memory of your work.

posts.name: Microsoft IQ
posts.tagline: Give AI agents a shared understanding of your business
posts.description: Microsoft IQ connects business knowledge, workplace activity, data, and web intelligence to help AI agents understand your organization and make smarter decisions.

posts.name: worldinmotion
posts.tagline: Encrypted messages between AI agents, across vendors
posts.description: Open-source, end-to-end encrypted messaging between AI agent sessions (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, any MCP client) across machines, built to cross accounts. The relay sees only metadata, never the text. No account, no telemetry. Set up with: npx worldinmotion setup

posts.name: ICONS
posts.tagline: Where brands book creators, or license their AI likeness
posts.description: ICONS is where brands book creators, influencers and celebrities for sponsored posts, or license a creator's likeness for AI content. Creators set their rates and approve every script and final cut. Contracts and payments live in one place.

posts.name: OX212
posts.tagline: Don't predict the market, predict the trader
posts.description: OX212 reads you while you trade, sees you about to break your plan and pauses the account when your rules say so. Every decision sealed in Bitcoin. Works with NinjaTrader, Tradovate, MT5, Quantower, cTrader, ChatGPT and Claude.

posts.name: Yetly
posts.tagline: Small real-world challenges near you, on your own map
posts.description: Yetly turns real places around you into small challenges: have a picnic by a lake, join a guided tour, cycle to a park. Browse nearby ideas across nature, cycling, hiking, culture and city exploring, or grab a ready-made day plan with a few easy stops. Each challenge you finish becomes a footprint on your own map, and you can turn it into a share card. Free for iPhone, no account needed.

posts.name: LinkBit
posts.tagline: Free URL shortener your AI agent can use (MCP + API)
posts.description: LinkBit is a free URL shortener with click analytics, custom slugs, UTM builder and QR codes. A REST API and an MCP server let Claude, Cursor or n8n create links and pull click stats for you, and a Telegram bot shortens any link you send it. No credit card needed.

posts.name: Confidential Cloud
posts.tagline: Private AI cloud that can't see your stuff
posts.description: When you press send on a prompt, do you wonder where it went, and who can read it? Confidential Cloud is the cloud for AI where your data stays protected end to end: encrypted at rest, in transit, and in CPU memory, and protected in GPU memory. The infrastructure provider can't read it. The data center can't. We can't. Every instance returns an attestation report you verify before sending data. Confidential VMs, NVIDIA B300 GPUs, and an MCP server for agents. Now in public Beta.

posts.name: StoicCloud
posts.tagline: Cloud storage for films that only your Mac can read
posts.description: The shoot's done and the disk is full. StoicCloud keeps every film in the cloud, encrypted on your Mac before it leaves, so even we only hold noise. Play it instantly in Stoic Player, open it from a Finder drive in DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or Premiere Pro, or share it with a link. 10 GB free with every Stoic Player licence, then 100 GB to 4 TB, or bring your own bucket.

posts.name: Rithub
posts.tagline: Own code host, move from GitHub in 5 minutes
posts.description: Rithub is your own Git host at rithub.dev: repos, pull requests, issues and CI, plus a guided importer that moves a GitHub repo over in about 5 minutes (walkthrough: rithub.dev/assets/seo/move-from-github-5-minutes.html). See how it compares to GitHub at rithub.dev/assets/seo/rithub-vs-github.html. Ritgram, the social layer for your commits and releases, runs alongside it at ritgram.rithub.dev. Free to start.

posts.name: Vanira
posts.tagline: Voice, video & multimodal AI agent infrastructure
posts.description: Vanira is infrastructure for real-time voice, video and multimodal AI agents. Agents talk to people, see what they show on camera or screen, and get work done: video KYC, claims checks, AI interviews, onboarding and support. Developers build with our SDKs and APIs; enterprises can run the full stack on-premise, fine-tuned models included. Inbound Pilot, our AI receptionist for small businesses, runs on Vanira.

posts.name: Ody Ai Business Phone
posts.tagline: Shared workspace + manageable AI agents
posts.description: Already trusted by 4K+ businesses. Ody combines a shared team workspace on one business number with highly manageable AI agents. Rare to get both. Native iOS + Android (+ web). AI calls inbound and outbound, AI texting, and workflows for the granular details that matter: AI voice-to-text, link tracking, REST API, SDKs, MCP, and Switchboard. Port your number. 7-day free trial.

posts.name: Orken
posts.tagline: Tell it your time and gear. Get a workout built for you.
posts.description: Ready-made workouts are the same for everyone, and training plans want 12 weeks. Orken builds a workout for today instead. Choose how much time you have (10–60 min) and home or gym, then pick strength, cardio, or mobility and core. Every workout fits your level and the gear you have, and a guided timer with sound and haptics takes you through it. Free to download, no account, no ads, works offline.

posts.name: kwatch
posts.tagline: Kubernetes alerts that name the root cause
posts.description: kwatch finds the one cause behind a Kubernetes failure and sends one message: what broke, why, who changed it, what to do next. To Slack, Teams, email and 50+ channels. Source available (ELv2); Pro free during early access.

posts.name: Hirekal
posts.tagline: Screen candidates with structured video interviews
posts.description: Hirekal helps recruiting teams and agencies streamline candidate screening with asynchronous video interviews. Create structured interviews, collect candidate responses on their own schedule, and review submissions without the back-and-forth of scheduling calls. Collaborate with your team, review transcripts and communication scores, and share candidate presentations with stakeholders to make screening more efficient and consistent.

posts.name: craving
posts.tagline: Outgrow your link in bio with a page that chats and sells
posts.description: craving gives you one page where people find your socials, your feed, links, can get in touch directly and buy what you offer. Your AI assistant can answer their questions, at any time of day. Use it as your homepage, a link in your bios, your shop or a business card. Our live portraits make your Home feel alive right away.

posts.name: Rage Bait
posts.tagline: Fact-check the whole room, live, from your iPhone
posts.description: Rage Bait listens to a conversation, picks out each claim and who said it, and checks it against sources while you're still talking. Every claim gets Checks out, Sus or Lies, and every voice gets a tally. The audio never leaves your phone. Press kit: ragebait.monster/press

posts.name: Kenso
posts.tagline: The outbound agent that finds and wins your dream accounts
posts.description: Kenso is the outbound platform that B2B teams use to send great outbound. Ken (our agent) maps everyone who decides and finds a reason to write now: a new hire, a funding round, a job change. Then it comments on their posts, builds each one a personal asset and sends researched emails and LinkedIn messages until they're ready to meet. It creates thousands of tests and learns from your feedback. Inboxes, workflows, leads, signals, CRM sync and call notes, in one app or from Claude and ChatGPT.

posts.name: Intellemo Cinematic Stories
posts.tagline: AI video you can direct, one scene at a time
posts.description: Make multi-scene AI videos with your own characters and products. Approve the script, audio and storyboard before generating video. Revise a single shot while keeping the rest of the cut. Built for product ads, launch films and brand stories.

posts.name: Surface
posts.tagline: The optimization layer for any website or landing page
posts.description: Optimize your website from your coding agent. Surface's MCP server gives Claude Code, Codex and other agents a full experimentation toolkit: wire Surface into any page, create variants, read live conversion data, and promote winners. Surface adapts to live user behavior, so results compound month after month.

posts.name: FeelEase
posts.tagline: Explore your emotions, your way. See patterns over time.
posts.description: FeelEase is a space for the moments when something stirs inside — frustration, joy, uncertainty, or simply something you want to notice. Express it in the way that fits the moment: with a metaphorical card, drawing, words, mood check-in, or a short practice. Reflect on your own or with AI Companion, save what matters, and over time see what becomes visible across your reflections.

posts.name: OnePDF Web Studio
posts.tagline: 100% client-side free online PDF toolkit
posts.description: 100% free, client-side private PDF utility suite. Merges, compresses, converts, and encrypts documents locally in browser RAM with zero server uploads.

posts.name: No Walls!
posts.tagline: Every wall ends up in ruins.
posts.description: A brick breaker on real maps, where the bricks are real border walls and you get to knock them down

posts.name: Esgenix
posts.tagline: Protect your innovation at the speed of AI
posts.description: AI is accelerating innovation. Why should protecting an innovation still take weeks or months? 𝗘𝘀𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗶𝘅 turns an invention idea into examiner-ready patent claims, specifications and drawings. Humans strategise, Esgenix executes. 𝗔𝗹𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘆 𝘁𝗿𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗱 by IP law firms and gaining traction with leading EV manufacturers. Patenting is hard. Esgenix delivers, so we charge for 𝗼𝘂𝘁𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘀, 𝗻𝗼𝘁 𝘀𝗲𝗮𝘁𝘀.

posts.name: DYSPLAY
posts.tagline: Video calls built for selling, with AI insights to sell more
posts.description: DYSPLAY helps sales teams showcase products, understand buyers, and boost conversion. Host video calls in your own branded showroom. Present products in 3D, review documents together, and get contracts signed live. AI captures more than the conversation: it knows what was on screen and how buyers engaged, helping reps uncover objections and prepare for the next call. After the call, share the showroom and see what buyers open. Reps get the full picture, managers get coaching insights.

posts.name: TruePrivacy
posts.tagline: Data Privacy Operations, Automated
posts.description: Automate privacy compliance in one workspace. TruePrivacy handles data discovery, DSR automation, consent management, and AI governance, so your team stays compliant with India’s DPDP Act, GDPR, CCPA, and more. 14-day free trial, no credit card.

posts.name: Squish – Compress pdf to target size
posts.tagline: Free online PDF compressor
posts.description: Compress a PDF to the exact file size you need, right in your browser.

posts.name: Sitely 8 MCP + Visual Website Builder
posts.tagline: Sitely is a MCP + Visual website builder for iPad and Mac
posts.description: Build a stunning website in minutes with Sitely on Mac or iPad. Start with your favorite AI agent via MCP, import an existing website or designs from Figma or Sketch. Then make it yours in the visual editor.

posts.name: Devin Bots
posts.tagline: Engineering teammates that lead teams of AI agents
posts.description: A Devin Bot leads a team of agents to build, test, and improve your software. Give it a job, not a task: keep Android at parity with iOS, keep CI under 5 minutes, run your releases. It plans, runs Devins in parallel, and brings back tested PRs.

posts.name: Signup Giant
posts.tagline: Ad-free sign-up sheets for schools, teams, and volunteers
posts.description: Signup Giant is an ad-free alternative to sign-up sheet sites. Describe your event in plain English and get ready-made slots. Parents and volunteers sign up from their phones in seconds, no account needed. Free to start; $6 for a month of unlimited sheets.

posts.name: Pure Memorial
posts.tagline: Remember them together, wherever the family lives
posts.description: One quiet page for someone you love: their story, photos, a short video, memories from family in any country and the way to their grave. Verified with a death certificate, every memory checked before it appears, no ads. Print it as a family book or download everything at any time. Free to start.

posts.name: Quoteit
posts.tagline: Give journalists a story they can run
posts.description: Quoteit turns the documents you already have into press releases, spokesperson quotes and media Q&As journalists can run, in the voice of the person speaking. For founders, small teams and enterprises, with every claim linked to its source.

posts.name: FRAME 37
posts.tagline: Nostalgia in Every Frame
posts.description: FRAME 37 brings the nostalgia of analog photography to your phone. Load a film roll, capture 36 moments without instant previews or retakes, and experience the anticipation of developing your photos. Explore unique film looks, create retro Photo Booth strips, and rediscover the joy of capturing memories instead of chasing perfection.

posts.name: CSVbox 2.0
posts.tagline: Upload a spreadsheet. Get clean data in your app.
posts.description: CSVBox is a super simple spreadsheet UI for detecting and correcting errors in CSV data. You can use it when you repeatedly need to upload data to a system with a known schema (like setting up new customers in a SaaS product, uploading a catalog monthly)

posts.name: BillToPDF
posts.tagline: Create an invoice, estimate, or quote PDF
posts.description: BillToPDF turns line items into an A4 PDF. Use an invoice after the work, an estimate while pricing a job, a quote for a client quotation, or a receipt after payment. Fill the form, preview it, and download with no account. Free files include a small Made with billtopdf.com line. It does not file taxes or give legal or tax advice.

posts.name: Pitchline AI
posts.tagline: Voice AI pitches your Sales Deck like your best rep
posts.description: Pitchline AI turns your sales deck into a Voice PDF with a voice AI rep that knows your company, not just your slides. Give it your website, docs, FAQs, pricing, objection handling and sales playbook. When a buyer opens the link, it presents each slide, stops when they interrupt, answers like your best rep would and offers a call with you when they're ready. You see every question asked and time on each slide, synced to HubSpot and Salesforce. Free plan, no card needed.

posts.name: Sinapsis
posts.tagline: A single contract for the AI ecosystem
posts.description: A single contract for the AI ecosystem. Package models, libraries and custom Python code as reusable Templates. Connect them through consistent component interfaces and shared data structures, then compose and execute them as either realtime or event-driven complete AI systems, without being locked into a single model provider, framework or runtime. https://github.com/SinapsisHub/sinapsis-hub

posts.name: Metribay
posts.tagline: See what changed across your projects. Know where to act.
posts.description: See which project needs attention before opening a dozen tabs. Metribay puts traffic, search results and revenue alongside releases, so you can spot changes and decide what to work on next. Your numbers stay ready to check, with repeatable calculations and no prompt needed. There is a hosted Cloud version, which handles hosting and Google/GitHub app setup. The Core version is open source: you can inspect the code, or host it yourself with your own connector apps.

posts.name: Hidden Ties
posts.tagline: See the AI stack behind any company
posts.description: Look up any company to see its AI stack or any AI provider to see its customers, including unannounced ones. Hidden Ties reads 35+ types of technical records to find them, with a source behind each. Built for sales teams, investors and builders.

posts.name: BrokenProduct
posts.tagline: UX Audit for Founders. Report in 12 hours
posts.description: AI-powered UX audit browser extension for founders. Works on SaaS products, web apps, websites, landing pages, and mobile apps. Delivers a detailed, human-reviewed UX audit report within 12 hours.

posts.name: Musuni
posts.tagline: Reads your music numbers and plans your next release
posts.description: Type your artist name and get an honest read of where your music stands and the three moves to make next. Then Musuni works like a manager: plans your release, schedules posts, drafts pitches that go out only with your OK. No bots or promised streams.

posts.name: Your Next Tours
posts.tagline: Your voice in every participant's phone. No rented headsets.
posts.description: Your Next Tours turns a tour guide's phone into a live audio broadcast. Participants scan a QR code and listen on their own phones in the browser, no app or account. It runs on a local WiFi network with no internet, or online with live translation into any language.

posts.name: GitRanks Contribute
posts.tagline: Invest your AI tokens in the open source you build on
posts.description: GitRanks Contribute finds open-source issues that fit your skills. Your own coding agent, or ours on your Claude API key, works on them, and you review and submit each pull request under your name. Free, in Beta.

posts.name: OctoGit
posts.tagline: A better GitHub client for mobile
posts.description: ​I built OctoGit because managing GitHub repositories on a phone shouldn't feel slow or clunky. It's a clean, fast, and developer-focused mobile client designed to help you stay productive on the go. The app is currently in beta, so you might encounter occasional bugs or missing features during daily use. Feel free to report them or share any feedback—it really helps shape the upcoming updates!

posts.name: Threadz
posts.tagline: Human First AI
posts.description: The philosophy behind Threadz is to give back control to the human. Your thoughts and words go in first and Threadz only critiques them while the onus of perfecting your writing lies on you entirely. This is for those who value human creativity and control. It helps them embrace AI without the fears of losing creative freedom and control.

posts.name: CloudRoomy
posts.tagline: An encrypted cloud drive in Finder that takes no disk space
posts.description: CloudRoomy puts a cloud drive in your Finder sidebar. Files show their full size but use zero bytes until opened, and apps read only the parts they need. Everything is encrypted on your Mac. Plus Free Up Space, app offloading and on-device photo search.

posts.name: Camstalgia
posts.tagline: Shoot like it's 2010
posts.description: Camstalgia turns your iPhone into the phone cameras of 2007 to 2019. Pick one of 14 phones; its classic camera takes each photo in RAW, then develops it with that phone's photo size, lens view, sensor noise, sharpening, HDR and colour. Creative turns each year's look up; Technical keeps the measured processing. Every phone has its own camera screen and roll. No account, no ads, nothing uploaded. Your first 10 photos or videos are free.

posts.name: MONO — Minimal E-commerce Design System
posts.tagline: Minimal E-commerce Design System
posts.description: A minimal, responsive e-commerce Figma design system with 72 component sets, 579 variants, 122 design variables, 36 screen frames, and 7 prototype flows.

posts.name: Multiply Quest
posts.tagline: Free times tables practice that teaches. No ads or login
posts.description: A free times tables game built by a parent. No ads, no accounts, nothing collected. Kids learn a few facts at a time, get a trick and a picture when they miss one, and work through a quest map. Also does division, addition and subtraction.

posts.name: Lapser Studio
posts.tagline: Beautiful Timelapse Recordings. Effortlessly.
posts.description: Lapser Studio turns hours of work into beautiful, shareable timelapses automatically. Hit record, focus on your work (or game 😉), and export a polished video in seconds. Lives discreetly in the menu bar, light on CPU, powerful editing capabilities, with 40+ backgrounds or your own. No giant recordings to sort through and edit. Requires macOS 15+. To top it all off Lapser Studio is available via a lifetime license with free updates to boot.

posts.name: HelloMacroCalculator
posts.tagline: Your free Macro Calculator
posts.description: Free macro calculator to estimate daily calories, protein, carbohydrates, and fat. Understand what macros are and personalize targets for your goals.

posts.name: Agen Keys
posts.tagline: Permissions dashboard for every AI assistant
posts.description: Connect your email, calendar, files and docs once, and set each one to Full, Read only, or Off. Then give each Muse, Dots, Instinct, and more, their own keys. Remove an assistant any time and its key stops working.

posts.name: Viroan
posts.tagline: Trading bots checked before they are sold
posts.description: Viroan is a marketplace for trading algorithms: trading bots, indicators and tools for MetaTrader, cTrader and self-hosted platforms. Every product is checked by Viroan before it is sold, and its certificate says what the check covered.

posts.name: xnftables
posts.tagline: A deny-by-default firewall thought experiment and template
posts.description: A deny-by-default Linux nftables thought experiment and template. A starting point for tightly scoped private assets, not a production-ready policy or security guarantee.

posts.name: BotSay
posts.tagline: See the page to write next, and proof it worked
posts.description: Every week BotSay asks AI engines the questions your buyers ask. It ranks the pages to write and the sites to be on by how many answers each could win. Mark the day you publish, and it shows how many more answers name you.

posts.name: Holly OS
posts.tagline: Scan business cards and never miss a follow-up
posts.description: Turn business cards into relationships you can actually manage. Scan both sides, save where you met and what you discussed, organize notes, opportunities, and next steps, then draft personalized follow-up emails to review. Free on iPhone in English and Korean.

posts.name: Pluto
posts.tagline: Your private AI workspace for meetings, notes, and tasks
posts.description: Pluto brings your meetings, notes, and tasks together around the people and projects they belong to. Record a call, write a brief, or track a commitment. Ask “Why did we change the launch date?” and follow the answer back to the conversation or note. Pluto is free and open source for Apple Silicon Macs. Recording and transcription happen on your Mac, and you can run the AI locally too.

posts.name: Hootle
posts.tagline: A tiny owl that keeps your Mac awake, and knows when to stop
posts.description: Keep-awake apps are easy to forget. Leave one on and your MacBook sits awake all night at 3% battery. Hootle is a little owl that keeps your Mac awake while you need it, then lets it sleep: when the battery runs low, when your call or slides app closes, or when nobody answers "Anyone there?". 10 free owls. Free on the Mac App Store.

posts.name: Voyager 1 by Voicefinder
posts.tagline: AI voices you direct like an actor, mixed and mastered
posts.description: Voyager 1 is an AI voice model you direct like an actor. Write the script, tell each line how to feel in plain words and set how intense, from natural to maximum. 800+ voices in 55+ languages, or clone yours from under 10 seconds. It comes back finished: 6,000+ sound effects, music and a master at 48 kHz for TV, YouTube or podcast. 1.53% word error rate on Seed-TTS, below human recordings (2.13%). Edit it on a real timeline, or let your AI agent produce the whole piece via MCP.

posts.name: SimplePost
posts.tagline: AI-native social scheduler for the agent you already use
posts.description: SimplePost is an AI-native social media scheduler built for the AI agent you already use. Write in ChatGPT, Claude or another compatible agent with your own context and model, then preview, schedule and publish to 10 networks from the same chat. A standalone web scheduler is included, and the full code is MIT open source.

posts.name: iGamRadar
posts.tagline: Spot rising iGaming brands in any market
posts.description: iGamRadar ranks 5,000+ casino and betting brands across 140+ markets by real search demand. Monthly country rankings, brand profiles and the IGR Index (one 0-100 score for brand demand) help operators, affiliates and analysts spot rising brands early.

posts.name: ShopPilot
posts.tagline: AI marketing coworker
posts.description: ShopPilot is an AI coworker that automates your marketing work in Shopify, Google Ads, Meta Ads and Klaviyo. 14 days free, then $19.95/month.

posts.name: Ziru
posts.tagline: Wake up tired? How you feel, why, and what to do next
posts.description: Each morning Ziru answers three questions: how you feel, why, and what to do next. It reads the sleep and heart data already on your iPhone and checks it against your own usual. Any watch, ring or band, or just your phone. No account.

posts.name: WickIQ
posts.tagline: Get more clients. Grow your business. Get the work done.
posts.description: WickIQ helps small business owners, coaches, consultants, and professional service firms attract clients and grow. Its LinkedIn Growth Engine supports prospecting, personalized outreach, and appointment setting. Qualifying managed-service plans include a guarantee of 10 qualified booked appointments per month beginning in Month 2. Wick connects sales, CRM, marketing, retention, and operations to help you identify priorities and get the work done.

posts.name: Authentify
posts.tagline: The authorization layer for autonomous agents
posts.description: Authentify checks every action an AI agent takes, gets human approval when it matters, and keeps a tamper-evident record regulators can verify.

posts.name: Kinse
posts.tagline: Check-in conversations and medication reminders by phone
posts.description: Kinse is a phone service for families who help a loved one from a distance. You pick the days and times, and Cora, the voice on every Kinse call, calls them for a short conversation and reminders about their medication, meals, routines, and appointments. After each call, you get a short summary to start your next call or visit from. It works with any phone, home or cell, old or new, with no app to learn. Talk with Cora yourself for 3 minutes first, with no credit card.

posts.name: Veranda
posts.tagline: Quiet social journal for your circle & memory books
posts.description: Instagram made us perform for strangers. Veranda brings you back to real life. Cap your network at 150 close friends and a 25-person Inner Circle. No algorithms, no follower counts, no ads. Just chronological photos, 30s song previews, rest logs, places and printable A4 PDF Memory Books at year-end. Works solo, with one partner or with your crew. Explore live preview with zero login.

posts.name: Ownbox
posts.tagline: Your AI agents, finally working together. Owned, not rented.
posts.description: Ownbox is the anti-SaaS Business OS where your team and your AI agents finally work together. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT and other compatible agents work from one Shared Company Brain through your own MCP server: agents propose, your people approve. A Business Agent and Machines like the SEO Machine come built in. $149 a month for 12 payments, then it's yours.
